Headline: 🏆 IRYS Trading Competition — Share 500,000 IRYS!
Prize pool: 500K IRYS
Start: 2026-11-25T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-02T23:59:00Z

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The IRYS Trading Competition is here!
## Trade IRYS/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 500,000 IRYS prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 25 — December 02, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade IRYS_USDT during the event period
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible IRYS/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative IRYS/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled IRYS/USDT trades during the campaign.
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (500,000 IRYS):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 80,000 IRYS | 150,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 55,000 IRYS | 100,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 25,000 IRYS | 50,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 140,000 IRYS by Trading Volume | 35,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 200,000 IRYS by Trading Volume | 20,000 USDT
Qualified users will share 500,000 IRYS based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1.You must complete the campaign sign-up on this page to be eligible to participate.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible IRYS/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.

## Growth Points Tasks

## Notes
- For details on Social Growth Points tasks, how to earn Growth Points, and level rules, please refer to the Gate Social Growth Points Guide . Update to version 8.33.0 or later to access the latest tasks.

- To claim rewards, complete identity verification and reach a total trading volume of at least $50 before the end of each event. Eligible new users must register during the event, complete identity verification. No trading volume required for new users. Trading volume = Buy Volume + Sell Volume.
- Position Voucher are valid for 7 days. Please use them within the validity period. Multiple Futures Vouchers can be stacked. Guide to using Position Voucher .
- If you win a Lucky Bag, the reward will be distributed according to the following formula:
(Your Lucky Bag Quantity / Total Lucky Bags Drawn) × $200 worth of Tokens.
7. If you win Gate merch, please fill in your shipping address on the prize page on time. The item will be airdropped to your Gate Shop page. Failure to claim it will be considered a forfeiture of the prize, and the merchandise will not be reissued.

After verification, the rewards will be sent. Please keep an eye on your logistics information. If delivery fails due to logistics issues, merch will be issued as an equivalent Position Voucher (Gate Tri-Fold Keyboard as $100 Position Voucher).

10. Participants must complete identity verification before the event ends to qualify for rewards.Sub-accounts and main accounts, as well as multiple accounts with the same KYC information, will be treated as the same participant.
11. Any form of cheating will result in the disqualification of prize claims.
12. In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
13. Gate reserves all rights to the final explanation.
